verdict.rationale: Brave Search API supports domain exclusion/inclusion via query syntax (e.g., site:github.com, minus operator for exclusion) and Goggles for boosting/demoting specific websites and domains, directly enabling developers to restrict or exclude domains from results. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of domain exclusion working as documented, and no dedicated first-party parameter (like an 'exclude_domains' field) beyond query operators and Goggles re-ranking.
